resources.string: Make an animated card and send it by chat or text.
More cards for this category are coming soon!
Christmas card: Night in the forest
The recipient explores it: light up the cabin, grow the tree, welcome the snow and get a greeting with their name.
Wake the tipsy Santa with a bucket of water, find a reindeer to pull the sleigh, load the gifts and deliver them down the chimney.
Santa flies by dropping gifts. Drag the stocking to catch all 9, then the big gift opens with a greeting for the recipient.
Tap to fly the reindeer sleigh past pine trees and sleepy reindeer. After 5 gates Santa drops the gift with a greeting for the recipient.
Pick the right gift box to find a cake, place the candle, light it and blow it out. A birthday greeting card appears with the Happy Birthday song.
Turn the page to a quiet snowy Japanese scene with your wishes.
Blow out the burning candle to reveal your birthday wishes and song.
Touch the clock at midnight: fireworks burst and your New Year wishes appear.
Call the boy, the girl and the puppy into a snowy Korean courtyard to unlock your wishes.
